title: Corporate LE evidence narrative corpus

Company MDM / asset inventory fields — no carrier IMEI triangulation
DLP + chain-of-custody on media the company seized under policy
Company-held bank/ERP/PAC exports — no live SWIFT gateway
Company-administered mail/chat under hold — decrypt/intercept remains constrained
Facility coordinates and lease GPS fixtures — no live device tracking
Narrative typology only — SIGINT collection is wont-do
FRE 803(6) regularly kept PAC / wire memo packets
Log sequence + timestamp provenance under FRE 901
